text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: “—This is the path I have chosen.”

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (...What is it?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be someone who guides you—
who guides all of you."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (...Tch, shut up, shut up, shut UP!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaargh—!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
…………
...Tch, damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(...I got distracted.
What was that "voice" just now...?)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOH, that was incredible!
That final burst was insane!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. She didn't take 1st, but...
The Symboli named Sirius is quite something too!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: "She was a favorite of the Symboli family from the very start, wasn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I'd certainly like to keep an eye on her future performances~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She couldn't win.
Yet the world's eyes were fixed on her. Surely,
this will serve as her stepping stone to the world stage...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At any rate, wishing to convey this situation, I hurried toward the underground tunnel. But—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...
...Next is the Kikuka Sho, then.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Holding off the fierce onslaught with a textbook front-running strategy, she claimed victory by 3/4 of a length.
Becoming the first undefeated Triple Crown champion in Japanese history.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...That built throne must have glittered so brightly in that very moment.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"To overwrite that,
a worthy run will be required. In other words—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Who else is there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until right after the Nippon Derby,
I had no idea Symboli Rudolf had
completely captivated her mind.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Regardless, next up is the Kikuka Sho.
We need to build stamina to prepare for the long-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll win for sure.
I'll win—and paint over everything...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"My feelings toward Symboli Rudolf
are merely one of many motivations."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her steadily push forward,
I had felt reassured, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That evening, a flicker of unease flared up once again—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Making a fuss the moment you get home.
...What do you want?

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wanted to consult with you as soon as possible!
You see—

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
We were wondering if you would accompany
Rudolf-san on her overseas challenge...!

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
"Timeline-wise, the plan is to proceed
as soon as the upcoming Kikuka Sho is over."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A "companion" for an overseas campaign refers to an Umamusume who acts as a training partner and confidante for the main contender, fulfilling a supportive role.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's not the main focus, entering the race is possible...
and above all, it's a great chance to scout the course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First of all, would her pride even allow her
to take on the role of Symboli Rudolf's companion—?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...It's annoying, but weighing the pros and cons,
it's not a bad deal.

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Committee Member
text_block_list.text: Does that mean...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Let me do it.
I'll throw away my useless pride for this.

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Committee Member
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Change of plans. Reorganize everything.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Chances like this don't come around often.
I wanna run on their turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, they say the turf in Japan and Europe
is quite different. If you can run in that race,
it will be an invaluable experience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so...
We abruptly changed course toward an overseas expedition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The situation began changing rapidly from an unexpected direction.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First is the Kikuka Sho.
And after that, preparing to be a travel companion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In addition... I also need to properly address that issue I noticed after the race.
